text:
Ari: hey everyone \o/ i'm Ari — joining as an AE next week. need to get HubSpot, Gong, Dialpad softphone, demo laptop, and the current playbook + one-pager bundle. also curious where the quick email templates live and who does custom slide builds. any pro tips for week 1 shadowing?
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Ari! :tada: Provision ticket created: https://redwood.in/onboard/Ari. Complete the form to request seats & hardware. You'll be auto-added to #sales-onboarding.
Monica (sales-ops): hi @Ari — i'll handle HubSpot, Gong, and Dialpad. Fill the provisioning form and include your preferred alias and caller ID string. Turnaround usually <24h during weekdays.
Ari: form submitted. alias ari@redwood.com. caller ID: "Redwood - Ari". prefer softphone.
Monica (sales-ops): got it, queued. I'll post the Gong invite here when sent.
Ben (IT): Ari — for the demo laptop do you want mac-arm, mac-intel, or ubuntu-22? we build images and push via MDM. Post-image run the bootstrap:
```
bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://dl.redwood/bootstrap-onboard.sh | sudo bash"
```
Tell me which OS and i'll start the build.
Ari: mac-arm please.
Ben (IT): starting image build now, ETA ~3 hours. You'll receive an email with temporary creds and instructions. If you need Dialpad sooner, download the app and i'll push credentials once your account provisions.
Kai (AE-buddy): welcome @Ari! i'll DM you the "week0" playbook, 3 sample call recordings, objection cheat sheet, and the shadow calendar. i'm free Tue 10:30 or Thu 2pm to have you shadow.
Ari: Tue 10:30 works — thanks Kai.
Sasha (marketing): @Ari i'll add you to the collateral drive and email templates repo: https://drive.redwood/sales/collateral. Templates include cold intro, trial follow-up, and industry-specific decks. For custom slides DM me the company logo + one-liner and i'll put together a 3-slide pack.
Ari: perfect. thanks Sasha. one more — where's the consent language for recordings and Loom templates?
Tools Bot: Loom and recording license provisioning handled by Tools. Consent wording + templates live at https://drive.redwood/sales/demo-resources. Tools will grant read access after provisioning.
Monica (sales-ops): small ops note: complete the Learning module "Demo checklist" before your first shadow. It covers consent phrasing, call tagging, and HubSpot note conventions.
Ari: will do tonight. thanks for the speedy responses everyone! excited to get started :rocket:
